label: Mold or damp spot
description: Dark spots, staining or a musty patch on a wall, ceiling or window.

required_shots.prompt: Step back and show the whole room
required_shots.tip: Stand in the doorway so the affected spot is in frame.
required_shots.hint: A wide shot of the room with the affected area visible somewhere in frame.

required_shots.prompt: Get close to the affected spot
required_shots.tip: About an arm's length away, in good light.
required_shots.hint: A sharp close-up of the discoloured, stained or damp area.

required_shots.tip: Tilt up so the ceiling fills the frame.
required_shots.hint: The ceiling directly above the affected area.

required_shots.prompt: Show the wall next to it
required_shots.tip: Include the corner where the walls meet.
required_shots.hint: The neighbouring wall or the other side of this wall.
required_shots.skip_label: There's no wall next to it

required_shots.prompt: Any window, pipe or vent nearby?
required_shots.tip: Capture whatever could be letting moisture in.
required_shots.hint: A nearby window, pipe, vent, bathroom fixture or other possible moisture source.

questions.q: How long has it been visible?

severity_guide: a few small spots (under 0.1 m²) on a wipeable surface, no smell, no moisture source
a small patch (under 0.5 m²), or recurring spots on sills, caulking or tiles
moderate spread (0.5-3 m²) on drywall or a ceiling, visible for months, or a musty smell
a large area (3-10 m²), several surfaces, or a likely ongoing moisture source
over 10 m², spreading into a basement, attic or crawl space, or active water or flooding

rules: Never say the spot IS mold, and never name a mold species or call it toxic or black mold.
Describe what is visible (discolouration, staining, spotting) and recommend testing.
